stops.note: Nicolas Chauvin, supposedly a fanatically loyal soldier of Napoleon, was probably invented; the Cogniard brothers' 1831 play La Cocarde tricolore made him a byword for jingoism
meant a blind patriot; 'male chauvinist' spread with the women's movement around 1970

current_meaning: a person with prejudiced loyalty to their own group, especially a male chauvinist
